{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure clean state
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
n_rows = len(penguins_clean)
print('Number of rows after dropping missing values in both variables:', n_rows)

# Compute the Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print('Pearson correlation coefficient:', correlation)

# Extract the value for the report
print('correlation_value:', correlation)"}
